properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 VPCCoreAndRouting activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AcceptVpcPeeringConnection", "Execute", "VPC",
    "AssignPrivateNatGatewayAddress", "Set", "NAT Gateway",
    "AssociateDhcpOptions", "Set", "VPC",
    "AssociateNatGatewayAddress", "Set", "NAT Gateway",
    "AssociateRouteServer", "Set", "VPC",
    "AssociateRouteTable", "Set", "VPC Route Table",
    "AssociateSubnetCidrBlock", "Set", "Subnet",
    "AssociateVpcCidrBlock", "Set", "VPC",
    "AttachClassicLinkVpc", "Set", "VPC",
    "AttachInternetGateway", "Set", "VPC",
    "CreateDefaultSubnet", "Create", "Subnet",
    "CreateDefaultVpc", "Create", "VPC",
    "CreateDhcpOptions", "Create", "Dhcp Options",
    "CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway", "Create", "Egress-only Internet Gateway",
    "CreateInternetGateway", "Create", "Internet Gateway",
    "CreateNatGateway", "Create", "NAT Gateway",
    "CreateRoute", "Create", "Route Table",
    "CreateRouteServer", "Create", "Route Server",
    "CreateRouteServerEndpoint", "Create", "Route Server Endpoint",
    "CreateRouteServerPeer", "Create", "Route Server Peer",
    "CreateRouteTable", "Create", "Route Table",
    "CreateSubnet", "Create", "Subnet",
    "CreateSubnetCidrReservation", "Create", "Subnet CIDR Reservation",
    "CreateVpc", "Create", "VPC",
    "CreateVpcPeeringConnection", "Create", "VPC Peering Connection",
    "DeleteDhcpOptions", "Delete", "DHCP Options",
    "DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway", "Delete", "Egress-only Internet Gateway",
    "DeleteInternetGateway", "Delete", "Internet Gateway",
    "DeleteNatGateway", "Delete", "NAT Gateway",
    "DeleteRoute", "Delete", "Route Table",
    "DeleteRouteServer", "Delete", "Route Server",
    "DeleteRouteServerEndpoint", "Delete", "Route Server Endpoint",
    "DeleteRouteServerPeer", "Delete", "Route Server Peer",
    "DeleteRouteTable", "Delete", "Route Table",
    "DeleteSubnet", "Delete", "Subnet",
    "DeleteSubnetCidrReservation", "Delete", "Subnet CIDR Reservation",
    "DeleteVpc", "Delete", "VPC",
    "DeleteVpcPeeringConnection", "Delete", "VPC Peering Connection",
    "DescribeClassicLinkInstances", "Read", "EC2 Classic Instances",
    "DescribeDhcpOptions", "Read", "DHCP Options",
    "DescribeEgressOnlyInternetGateways", "Read", "Egress-only Internet Gateway",
    "DescribeInternetGateways", "Read", "Internet Gateway",
    "DescribeNatGateways", "Read", "NAT Gateway",
    "DescribeRouteServerEndpoints", "Read", "Route Server Endpoint",
    "DescribeRouteServerPeers", "Read", "Route Server Peer",
    "DescribeRouteServers", "Read", "Route Sever",
    "DescribeRouteTables", "Read", "Route Table",
    "DescribeSubnets", "Read", "Subnet",
    "DescribeVpcAttribute", "Read", "VPC",
    "DescribeVpcClassicLink", "Read", "VPC Classic Link",
    "DescribeVpcClassicLinkDnsSupport", "Read", "VPC Classic Link",
    "DescribeVpcPeeringConnections", "Read", "VPC Peering Connection",
    "DescribeVpcs", "Read", "VPC",
    "DetachClassicLinkVpc", "Set", "VPC",
    "DetachInternetGateway", "Set", "VPC",
    "DisableRouteServerPropagation", "Disable", "Route Table",
    "DisableVgwRoutePropagation", "Disable", "Virtual Private Gateway",
    "DisableVpcClassicLink", "Disable", "VPC Classic Link",
    "DisableVpcClassicLinkDnsSupport", "Disable", "VPC Classic Link",
    "DisassociateNatGatewayAddress", "Set", "NAT Gateway",
    "DisassociateRouteServer", "Set", "VPC",
    "DisassociateRouteTable", "Set", "Route Table",
    "DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock", "Set", "Subnet",
    "DisassociateVpcCidrBlock", "Set", "VPC",
    "EnableRouteServerPropagation", "Enable", "Route Server",
    "EnableVgwRoutePropagation", "Enable", "Virtual Private Gateway",
    "EnableVpcClassicLink", "Enable", "VPC Classic Link",
    "EnableVpcClassicLinkDnsSupport", "Enable", "VPC Classic Link",
    "GetRouteServerAssociations", "Read", "Route Server",
    "GetRouteServerPropagations", "Read", "Route Server",
    "GetRouteServerRoutingDatabase", "Read", "Route Server",
    "GetSubnetCidrReservations", "Read", "Subnet",
    "GetVpcResourcesBlockingEncryptionEnforcement", "Read", "VPC",
    "ModifyRouteServer", "Set", "Route Server",
    "ModifySubnetAttribute", "Set", "Subnet",
    "ModifyVpcAttribute", "Set", "VPC",
    "ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions", "Set", "VPC Peering Connection",
    "ModifyVpcTenancy", "Set", "VPC",
    "RejectVpcPeeringConnection", "Execute", "VPC",
    "ReplaceRoute", "Set", "VPC Endpoint",
    "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation", "Set", "Subnet",
    "UnassignPrivateNatGatewayAddress", "Delete", "NAT Gateway Address"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName in ("AcceptVpcPeeringConnection", "CreateVpcPeeringConnection"),
        ResponseElements.vpcPeeringConnection,
      EventName == "AssignPrivateNatGatewayAddress", RequestParameters.PrivateIpAddress,
      EventName == "AssociateDhcpOptions", RequestParameters.DhcpOptionsId,
      EventName == "AssociateNatGatewayAddress", ResponseElements.natGatewayAddressSet,
      EventName == "AssociateRouteServer", ResponseElements.routeServerAssociation,
      EventName == "AssociateRouteTable", ResponseElements.associationId,
      EventName == "AssociateSubnetCidrBlock", ResponseElements.ipv6CidrBlockAssociation,
      EventName == "AssociateVpcCidrBlock",
        coalesce(ResponseElements.cidrBlockAssociation,ResponseElements.ipv6CidrBlockAssociation),
      EventName == "AttachClassicLinkVpc", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "AttachInternetGateway", RequestParameters.InternetGatewayId,
      EventName in ("CreateDefaultSubnet", "CreateSubnet"), ResponseElements.subnet,
      EventName in ("CreateDefaultVpc", "CreateVpc"), ResponseElements.vpc,
      EventName == "CreateDhcpOptions", ResponseElements.dhcpOptions,
      EventName == "CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway", ResponseElements.egressOnlyInternetGateway,
      EventName == "CreateInternetGateway", ResponseElements.internetGateway,
      EventName == "CreateNatGateway", ResponseElements.natGateway,
      EventName in ("CreateRouteServer", "ModifyRouteServer"), ResponseElements.routeServer,
      EventName == "CreateRouteServerEndpoint", ResponseElements.routeServerEndpoint,
      EventName == "CreateRouteServerPeer", ResponseElements.routeServerPeer,
      EventName == "CreateRouteTable", ResponseElements.routeTable,
      EventName == "CreateSubnetCidrReservation", ResponseElements.subnetCidrReservation,
      EventName == "EnableRouteServerPropagation", ResponseElements.routeServerPropagation,
      EventName == "ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions", RequestParameters.RequesterPeeringConnectionOptions,
      EventName == "ModifyVpcTenancy", RequestParameters.InstanceTenancy,
      EventName == "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation", ResponseElements.newAssociationId,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("AcceptVpcPeeringConnection", "CreateVpcPeeringConnection"),
        ResponseElements.vpcPeeringConnection.vpcPeeringConnectionId,
      EventName in ("AssignPrivateNatGatewayAddress", "DeleteNatGateway", "DescribeNatGateways",
        "UnassignPrivateNatGatewayAddress"), RequestParameters.NatGatewayId,
      EventName in ("AssociateDhcpOptions", "AssociateVpcCidrBlock", "AttachClassicLinkVpc",
        "AttachInternetGateway", "DeleteVpc", "DescribeVpcClassicLink", "DescribeVpcs", "DetachClassicLinkVpc",
        "DetachInternetGateway", "DisableVpcClassicLink", "DisableVpcClassicLinkDnsSupport",
        "DisassociateRouteServer", "EnableVpcClassicLink", "EnableVpcClassicLinkDnsSupport",
        "GetVpcResourcesBlockingEncryptionEnforcement", "ModifyVpcAttribute", "ModifyVpcTenancy"),
        RequestParameters.VpcId,
      EventName in ("AssociateNatGatewayAddress", "DisassociateNatGatewayAddress"),
        ResponseElements.natGatewayId,
      EventName in ("AssociateRouteServer", "DeleteRouteServer", "DescribeRouteServers",
        "EnableRouteServerPropagation", "GetRouteServerAssociations", "GetRouteServerPropagations",
        "GetRouteServerRoutingDatabase", "ModifyRouteServer"), RequestParameters.RouteServerId,
      EventName == "AssociateRouteTable", ResponseElements.associationId,
      EventName in ("AssociateSubnetCidrBlock", "DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock"), ResponseElements.subnetId,
      EventName in ("CreateDefaultSubnet", "CreateSubnet"), ResponseElements.subnet.subnetId,
      EventName in ("CreateDefaultVpc", "CreateVpc"), ResponseElements.vpc.vpcId,
      EventName == "CreateDhcpOptions", ResponseElements.dhcpOptions.dhcpOptionsId,
      EventName == "CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway", ResponseElements.egressOnlyInternetGateway.vpcId,
      EventName == "CreateInternetGateway", ResponseElements.internetGateway.internetGatewayId,
      EventName == "CreateNatGateway", ResponseElements.natGateway.natGatewayId,
      EventName in ("CreateRoute", "DeleteRoute", "DeleteRouteTable", "DescribeRouteTables",
        "DisableRouteServerPropagation", "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation"), RequestParameters.RouteTableId,
      EventName == "CreateRouteServer", ResponseElements.routeServer.routeServerId,
      EventName == "CreateRouteServerEndpoint", ResponseElements.routeServerEndpoint.routeServerEndpointId,
      EventName == "CreateRouteServerPeer", ResponseElements.routeServerPeer.routeServerPeerId,
      EventName == "CreateRouteTable", ResponseElements.routeTable.routeTableId,
      EventName == "CreateSubnetCidrReservation",
        ResponseElements.subnetCidrReservation.subnetCidrReservationId,
      EventName in ("DeleteDhcpOptions", "DescribeDhcpOptions"), RequestParameters.DhcpOptionsId,
      EventName in ("DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway", "DescribeEgressOnlyInternetGateways"),
        RequestParameters.EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId,
      EventName in ("DeleteInternetGateway", "DescribeInternetGateways"), RequestParameters.InternetGatewayId,
      EventName in ("DeleteRouteServerEndpoint", "DescribeRouteServerEndpoints"),
        RequestParameters.RouteServerEndpointId,
      EventName in ("DeleteRouteServerPeer", "DescribeRouteServerPeers"), RequestParameters.RouteServerPeerId,
      EventName in ("DeleteSubnet", "DescribeSubnets", "GetSubnetCidrReservations", "ModifySubnetAttribute"),
        RequestParameters.SubnetId,
      EventName == "DeleteSubnetCidrReservation", RequestParameters.SubnetCidrReservationId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVpcPeeringConnection", "DescribeVpcPeeringConnections",
        "ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions", "RejectVpcPeeringConnection"),
        RequestParameters.VpcPeeringConnectionId,
      EventName == "DescribeClassicLinkInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName in ("DescribeVpcAttribute", "DisassociateVpcCidrBlock"), ResponseElements.vpcId,
      EventName == "DescribeVpcClassicLinkDnsSupport", RequestParameters.VpcIds,
      EventName in ("DisableVgwRoutePropagation", "EnableVgwRoutePropagation"), RequestParameters.GatewayId,
      EventName == "DisassociateRouteTable", RequestParameters.AssociationId,
      EventName == "ReplaceRoute", RequestParameters.VpcEndpointId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
